items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: A Keto, little Keto, used to always make ninth chords.

ctx.x: Until I had the music, you know. I didn't know what I was making, you know, until I got to seeing the music. When did you start making ninths? Oh, I don't know about, I just can't remember what year. But anyhow, you remember? When guitar and banjo music first come out, that's the time I started making ninth chords. And then, we used to have some fellas used to play, what is Keto in there? Keto. I don't know. Keto was there, two Ketos, big Keto and little Keto. They was Keto. You ain't got none of them here. Those…
Well, was this after World War I or before?
